findings.title: Preserve partial charge state before re-raising.
findings.rationale: charge_all stores successful receipts locally, then re-raises GatewayError before returning them. A retry can therefore charge earlier orders twice if gateway.charge is not idempotent. Preserve partial receipts in the exception or result, or use a stable per-order idempotency key such as order.id.
